name: OrgSwitcher
description: Search and choose an organisation scope, with a responsive picker and an optional all-organisations choice.
signature: <O extends SwitcherOrganisation>({ organisations, value, onValueChange, recent, open: openProp, onOpenChange, labels: labelsProp, searchPlaceholder, className, }: OrgSwitcherProps<O>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: labels
props.description: Display and accessibility labels supplied by the application.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when open change occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: A choice was made (also when it is the current one: the caller may ignore it).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state, so a palette command or a shortcut can open it.

props.name: organisations
props.description: The complete hierarchy of selectable organisations, with stable IDs and parent links.

props.name: recent
props.description: Recently chosen organisation ids, most recent first (useRecentOrganisations).

props.name: value
props.description: The current scope: an organisation id, or null for all organisations.
